item.title: Graduation Checklist - Guide
item.description:
Graduation Checklist

Use this checklist to prepare for graduating from CCASH’s shared platform to your own self-hosted instance.

Operational Readiness

  • Your operation has been active for at least 3-6 months
  • You have consistent monthly engagement metrics
  • Your operation model is proven and stable
  • Your clients are aware of the upcoming transition

Technical Readiness

  • You have a Linux server meeting CCASH’s requirements
  • Your domain and SSL certificate are ready
  • You have basic DevOps capability or support arranged
  • Your blockchain network access is configured

Data Readiness

  • Your client records are complete and verified
  • Wallet balances are accurate
  • Audit trail is continuous with no gaps
  • Compliance records are export-ready

Migration Steps

  1. Contact CCASH to initiate the graduation process
  2. Receive your graduation kit (deployment scripts, configuration, migration tools)
  3. Deploy your self-hosted instance (CCASH provides support)
  4. Verify the deployment meets all requirements
  5. Migrate client data, transaction records, and audit history
  6. Verify data integrity — balances match, audit trail is continuous
  7. Cut over your client base to the self-hosted instance
  8. Update your DNS and branding

Post-Graduation

  • Your self-hosted instance is running and verified
  • Your operation is active on the new instance
  • You have access to ongoing CCASH platform updates
  • You can route money-services operations through CCASH if needed

Need help? Contact the CCASH team for deployment support.

item.title: Roadmap
item.description:
Knowledge Base

Platform Roadmap

What has shipped and what's coming next on the CCASH platform — from shared platform infrastructure to self-hosted graduation tooling.

Shipped

  • v0.7.1 — Core operator console (May 2026). Go + HTMX application platform with multi-currency wallets (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, INR fiat; USDT, USDC stablecoin; BTC, ETH crypto), send/receive/swap wizards with risk-tiered OTP approval gates, travel-cheque lifecycle (issue, redeem, convert, cancel), contacts directory, filterable transaction history, cryptographic audit trail, and seven user roles.
  • v0.7.0 — Whitelabel oversight role (April 2026). Aggregate operational visibility for whitelabel brand teams with PII-discipline enforced by architectural tests.
  • Site-profile brand parameterization (April 2026). Same binary boots as any operator brand by dropping a site-profile configuration.
  • Legal framework v1 (May 2026). Entity formation documents, governance policies, compliance procedures, and operational agreements ratified.
  • Website launch (June 2026). Full public website with product pages, knowledge base, glossary, and documentation.

See the Changelog for the full release history.

Platform Overview

CCASH is a whitelabel money-services platform — software that runs MSB, PSP, VASP and corporate-treasury operations, deployable on shared infrastructure or self-hosted. Launch as a Client Series operating as an Agent MSB under CCASH's US FinCEN registration. Graduate to your own self-hosted instance or your own license.
